objective: equal-weight squared deviation of subspace behavior and L15 transport from full-H3, complement behavior from base, plus normalized full-vocabulary match and complement KL; report mean and worst bank/panel
prediction: Pooled aligned rank1 beats matched-rank DIM on both mean and worst multi-reader objective. At least one noise/KL arm improves DIM full-vocabulary match plus inertness, but need not win the complete reader ensemble.
decision_rule: Only a frozen axis that beats DIM on independent readers licenses expensive multi-environment optimization. Otherwise change the causal operator/readers before fitting again.
fit_policy: zero new fit; every learned axis and regularization choice is inherited from earlier sealed experiments
